notes.title: Have just fixed the bug in customs clearance in some cases.
notes.notes: The specific situation is that when you are in a situation where a path is pointing out of the board, the game will think that you have formed a closed loop, which will trigger the clearance effect. . Currently this bug has been solved. Thanks for feedback from community players!
